_comment: Domain policy for the cheap triage stage (Phase G, backend/email_triage.py).
This file answers ONE question: what KIND of address is this? It does NOT
answer whether the sender is trusted -- that is Phase F's
data/trusted_email_senders.json, and the two are deliberately separate.
A corporate sender is not automatically trusted, and a personal one is not
personal_domains exists to avoid spending an LLM call on a message that is
almost certainly not a vendor invoice. It is an OPTIMISATION, never a
verdict: a small supplier really may invoice from a free-mail address, so a
PERSONAL sender with an invoice-shaped subject and a PDF still goes through
corporate_domains are this business's OWN domains -- used to recognise
internal mail and forwarded invoices, not to trust anybody.
